text:
maria: Heads up — provisioning alerts started ~15m ago in eu-west-1. New GPU nodegroups stuck in PendingAttach.
maria: Seeing this in node logs: "Error attaching IAM role: AccessDenied: Not authorized to perform iam:PassRole".
devon: That coincides with the KMS key policy tweak anika pushed around 12:30. Could be related to keystore -> we rotated the keystore role binding.
sam: I also saw firewall change that tightened stateful inspection on privnet earlier today from ops-team, might be blocking STS/iam endpoints via privatelink.
li: On it — checking kube-autoscaler events and ASG lifecycle hooks.
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout gpu-nodegroup-24 started by anika at 2026-03-20T12:28:10Z
maria: Paste of kubectl describe on one pending node:

```
Events:
  Type    Reason                 Age   From                Message
  ----    ------                 ----  ----                -------
  Warning FailedAttachVolume     5m    attachdetach        AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume "eni-token" : AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/gpu-provisioner/eks is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: role/keystore-provision
```

devon: That looks exactly like iam:PassRole no-perms. But why now — the role existed.
anika: I modified the key policy to restrict encrypt/decrypt to the new keystore principal. I did not touch iam:PassRole though.
li: Could be IAM role ARN changed in node bootstrap template and the new ARN doesn't exist in KMS grants. Also STS calls failing if privatelink blocked.
sam: Quick check — can anyone run `aws sts get-caller-identity` from a failing node? If STS fails it's network.
li: Ran it from a debug pod: get-caller-identity succeeded. But `aws iam pass-role` simulation fails: `An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the SimulatePrincipalPolicy operation: Not authorized`.

maria: Hmm, I think two simultaneous problems: 1) KMS policy tightened which removed a conditional that allowed the provisioner to pass the role, 2) the firewall tightening increased API latency hitting retries and exposing race during instance profile attach.
devon: Also audit-logging was flipped to full S3 logging for keystore ops this morning which caused a spike of PutObject requests. S3 was throttling and that cascaded into delays for role propagation checks.
anika: That was my change request — we needed full audit for the compliance run. Sorry, didn't foresee the cascade.

li: Mitigation proposal:
- roll back KMS policy to previous for keystore (temp)
- relax firewall rule 10.2.3.x -> allow STS/iam endpoints outbound via privatelink
- reduce audit S3 batch size / enable buffering to cut traffic
- bump warm pool for GPU nodegroup to cover in-flight capacity

maria: Can we do a quick rollback of the KMS policy and throttle audit ingestion? I can own the rollback.
sam: I can open a temporary firewall exception and test STS latency. Deploy team — can you hold GPU rollouts for 30m?

devon: Creating runbook steps now and a tiny rollback patch to push. devon -> patch: diff shows removed Condition on keystore Grant.

anika: If rollback helps we'll plan a safer KMS policy with explicit principals (instead of a broad restriction) and staged rollout.

aws-bot: [alert] S3 PUT request rate to s3://redwood-keystore-audit spiked x18 at 12:34Z, current throttling: 429 responses.
maria: That's the audit ingestion causing backpressure.

li: After KMS rollback and firewall relax (both done), observed one node bootstrap succeed and join the cluster at +7m.
li: Autoscaler resumed scale up. No more AccessDenied in last 3m.

maria: Cost note — the full audit logs mode added ~200k extra PUTs in 30m. Estimate ~ $45 extra for this event. We'll track in the incident cost sheet.
sam: Action items:
- anika: prepare staged KMS policy with explicit provisioner principal and doc (owner)
- devon: add assertion checks in bootstrap to surface PassRole failures earlier (owner)
- li: add a small e2e test that simulates audit S3 backpressure during node attach (owner)
- maria: add rollback runbook and update on-call playbook (owner)

anika: ack. I'll revert the compliance change in the patch branch and coordinate with compliance for a low-impact plan.
maria: Thanks. If anything else pops up ping me. I'll leave the rollback PR open for 1 hour then merge if green.

deploy-bot: [blocked] rollout gpu-nodegroup-24 paused by eng-platform at 2026-03-20T12:45:20Z : manual hold
maria: marking this thread for postmortem if cost > $100 and > 10 nodes impacted.

li: Logging: attached audit snippets and node join timestamps to the incident thread.

sam: tl;dr: simultaneous KMS deny + audit-induced S3 throttling + firewall tightening caused iam:PassRole failures during GPU node provisioning. Rollback and firewall relax fixed it. Follow-ups for safer staged policy and bootstrap checks.

maria: closing the immediate alert. We'll schedule a 30-min postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
